text: The two hands are read together: one shows what you were born with, the other what you have made of it. Books disagree about which hand is which, and this reading cannot tell which of your hands you use most, so it only describes how your two hands differ.
When the two hands match, what you were born with and what you have made of it agree: you are becoming who you were meant to be.
When the two hands differ, you have grown beyond where you started: life has changed you, and that change is part of your story.
When only one hand shows a line clearly, there is nothing to compare it with, so the two hands are not compared on it.
